chunks: And the Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام said:
Indeed, when death comes to the believer, the Angel of Death reassures and secures him; were it not for that, he would not become settled.

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنَ: the believer, the person characterized by iman
key_terms.حَضَرَهُ: came upon him or became present to him
key_terms.وَثَّقَهُ: reassured him, secured him, or gave him firmness

ai.seo_question: What happens to a believer when death comes according to Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a state that occurs for the believer at the moment of death. It indicates that Malak al-Mawt grants reassurance and composure to the believer, without which the believer would not remain settled at that moment.
